Subject: Recap & next steps from today — Summit Retail discovery

Olivia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap so we can align on the trial scope and owners.

Summary of what we heard from Summit Retail:
- Goal: validate automated product tagging and search relevancy for seasonal catalog (40k SKUs).
- Success criteria (high level): +12% click-through to product pages from search OR +8% conversion lift for search-driven sessions vs baseline in the 3-week trial.
- Data: feed will be a nightly S3 export (product metadata + images).
- Security: must pass basic network allowlist + SOC 2 evidence.

Proposed Redwood trial plan (draft):
1) Kickoff & infra prep (Week 0): confirm S3 access, IP allowlist, test dataset slice. Owner: Marcus (engineering lead).
2) Integration & baseline run (Week 1): ingest feed, run baseline model, verify metrics. Owner: Marcus + Brian (Summit IT).
3) Iteration & tuning (Week 2): apply caching, adjust batching/quantization profile, run AB tests. Owner: Karthik + Summit product.
4) Final readout (end Week 3): compare trial vs baseline, present recommendation and next steps. Owner: Karthik + Olivia.

As attachments I pulled together a one-page success criteria template and a tentative week-by-week gate schedule (v1). Please review and share owners/gaps. I can convert the schedule into shared calendar invites once we lock dates.

Next steps / asks for Summit Retail:
- Can you confirm the internal success metrics owner (product or analytics)?
- Do you have a preferred kickoff window next week (Feb 8–12) or the following week?
- Any legal/compliance contacts we should loop in before data access?

I attached SUM_POC_success_criteria_v1.xlsx and a proposed calendar stub for weekly check-ins.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
